content.text: In regions where traditional payment processors like Stripe and PayPal are blocked or unreliable, digital creators face significant challenges in automating their commerce operations. Google Apps Script offers a powerful solution for automating digital product delivery via cryptocurrency payments, allowing creators to regain control and efficiency over their sales processes. This post breaks down how to leverage Google Apps Script within a sovereign commerce stack to streamline order fulfillment and enhance the buyer experience.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Google apps

Google Apps Script is a cloud-based scripting language that allows you to extend Google Workspace applications. In the context of digital commerce automation, it provides a way to automate repetitive tasks such as order processing and product delivery. For creators operating in countries with payment restrictions, this means they can implement a seamless system that allows them to sell digital products without relying on conventional payment platforms. This capability enhances operational efficiency and ensures that creators can provide customers with instant access to their purchases, thus increasing customer satisfaction and retention.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-cloudflare-webhook-driven-crypto-payment-13|COREMERCH guide to architecture]]-behind-github-pages-free-digital-product-15|The Real]] of a sovereign commerce stack utilizing Google Apps Script integrates several components to ensure efficient operation. When a customer makes a purchase using a cryptocurrency payment processor like NOWPayments, a webhook is triggered. This webhook informs your Google Apps Script of the transaction, which then processes the order. The script retrieves order details, stores them in [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-supabase-order-database-digital-stores-works-how-15|supabase]] or Google Sheets, and automatically sends delivery emails with download links. A correctly configured sovereign stack can process orders in under 30 seconds, ensuring that customers receive their products immediately after payment confirmation.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This automation solution is specifically designed for digital creators operating in regions where mainstream payment options are unavailable or heavily restricted, such as Nigeria, Ghana, and Venezuela. By utilizing Google Apps Script within a sovereign stack, these creators can efficiently manage their online stores, retain complete data ownership, and avoid reliance on third-party platforms. This architecture empowers individuals to create and sell digital products without barriers, enabling a thriving ecosystem of creativity and entrepreneurship in underserved markets.
Google Apps Script automates complex tasks with ease.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The effective functioning of this automation system hinges on multiple components. Google Apps Script serves as the backend logic layer that processes webhooks from NOWPayments. Cloudflare Workers can handle high volumes of webhook events, processing up to 100,000 events per day on the free tier. Supabase or Google Sheets store order data, while Gmail or Resend can send automated emails with download links. Together, these technologies create a robust framework that supports digital commerce automation, ensuring reliability and scalability for creators.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this automation solution, start by selecting the Edge Commerce Stack for a comprehensive setup. Sign up for NOWPayments and configure your account to accept cryptocurrency payments. Next, set up your Google Apps Script to handle webhook requests and integrate it with Supabase or Google Sheets for data storage. After that, implement email sending capabilities using Gmail or Resend for delivery notifications. Finally, test the entire system to ensure that everything works as expected before launching your online store. You can find all necessary resources and templates at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?

Automated digital product delivery works by integrating a payment processor with a backend system that handles order fulfillment. Once a payment is confirmed through crypto, a webhook triggers the backend script to process the order, retrieve customer information, and send download links automatically, ensuring a smooth and efficient customer experience.
Cloudflare Workers can handle 100,000 webhook events daily for free.

Full automation means the store generates revenue while you sleep, processes orders while you travel, and delivers products while you build your next one. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys this complete automated pipeline under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents every technical step for creators who prefer to build it themselves. Both available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Set the webhook secret key before you test anything — this is the most commonly skipped step and it causes silent failures where webhooks arrive but are rejected before any processing occurs. Configure the same secret key string in your NOWPayments IPN settings and in your backend environment variables or Apps Script properties. Deploy your backend and confirm the endpoint returns HTTP 200 to a test POST request. Upload a test product file and configure it in your backend product list. Send a real mainnet transaction to your configured wallet address and watch your backend logs in real time. Confirm the webhook arrives, the signature validates, the transaction confirms on-chain, the order logs, and the delivery email sends with a working link.
Frequently Asked Questions
How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?

Automated digital product delivery involves integrating a payment processor like NOWPayments with a backend system that handles order fulfillment. Upon payment confirmation, a webhook triggers the backend to process the order, send customer information, and deliver download links automatically.
What is a webhook and how does it trigger order fulfillment?

A webhook is a method for one application to send real-time data to another whenever a specific event occurs, such as a successful payment. In this context, it triggers the backend to fulfill the order by processing transaction details and initiating product delivery.
Can I automatically send download links after a crypto payment confirms?

Yes, you can automatically send download links after a crypto payment confirms. By using tools like Google Apps Script and configuring your system to handle webhooks, you can set up an automated email delivery process that sends download links to customers immediately.
What components do I need for this automation?

You'll need several components: a payment processor like NOWPayments, a backend logic layer (Google Apps Script), a data storage solution (Supabase or Google Sheets), and an email service (Gmail or Resend) to facilitate order fulfillment and product delivery.
